programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Ocean Wanderer | S01E02
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks have lived on Earth since before the age of dinosaurs - they have been roaming the oceans for over 400 million years. Only today are scientists beginning to discover the secrets of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Big cats in a small world – Flood | E02

Surviving in this demanding environment forces leopards, lions and cheetahs to use all their skills. The Moelo herd is very exhausted. Faced with winter flooding, young cheetahs must make a difficult decision. Sephiri must choose between her family and her young ones. Canada. 2024. documentary series

programme.desc: «Race: Grand Prix of Arlington» The 2026 IndyCar season arrives with a total of 18 events in which races alternate on urban, permanent and oval circuits. The Spanish Álex Palou defends the 2025 title, the fourth achieved by Palou and which was added to those achieved in 2021, 2023 and 2024, and will once again be the driver to beat. The Barcelonan will seek the fifth title. Within his own team, Chip Ganassi Racing, he will have one of his toughest rivals, the New Zealander Scott Dixon, who seeks to achieve a seventh title to equal the most successful driver, the American A.J. Foyt. The Penske team with the American Josef Newgarden and the New Zealander Scott McLaughlin will also once again be a contender for the title. We must not forget the Arrow McLaren team of Mexican Pato O'Ward nor the Andretti Global to which the Australian Will Power has arrived from the Penske team. Palou will seek his second victory in the Indianapolis 500, where he won in 2025

programme.title: Indycar (T2026): Grand Prix of Arlington
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Maestro Obradovic» Nine-time European champion with five different teams. His passion, intensity and vehemence have marked European basketball for more than thirty years. Zeljko Obradovic was a world champion as a player with a legendary Yugoslav team before making an early move to the bench. It was in 1991, with Partizan Belgrade, the team of his life. His first season he was already European champion. Joventut, Real Madrid, Treviso, Panathinaikos and Fenerbahçe later saw him triumph. Along the way he has marked the lives and careers of hundreds of players. Many call him teacher. Obradovic returned home, to Partizan, where they adore him. And he closed the circle with his resignation in November 2025. In any case, he remains one of the main references of European basketball of all time

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Master Obradovic

programme.desc: «Race: Grand Prix of Arlington» The 2026 IndyCar season arrives with a total of 18 events in which races alternate on urban, permanent and oval circuits. The Spanish Álex Palou defends the 2025 title, the fourth achieved by Palou and which was added to those achieved in 2021, 2023 and 2024, and will once again be the driver to beat. The Barcelonan will seek the fifth title. Within his own team, Chip Ganassi Racing, he will have one of his toughest rivals, the New Zealander Scott Dixon, who seeks to achieve a seventh title to equal the most successful driver, the American A.J. Foyt. The Penske team with the American Josef Newgarden and the New Zealander Scott McLaughlin will also once again be a contender for the title. We must not forget the Arrow McLaren team of Mexican Pato O'Ward nor the Andretti Global to which the Australian Will Power has arrived from the Penske team. Palou will seek his second victory in the Indianapolis 500, where he won in 2025

Stormborn: Children of the Storm (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Stormborn»…In the third and final part of the Stormborn trilogy, the animals of the north face worsening weather in Autumn and the first stirrings of winter. Grey seals and reindeer turn their attention to mating, hormones run wild as males compete and young animals venture away from their parents for the first time. In Iceland, the cliff arctic fox family is thriving, but it's a different story for the foxes denning at the shore line. Only one of the cubs has survived, now abandoned by her parents, she must fend for herself. On the Monach Isles, 35,000 grey seals arrive for the annual breeding season. A pup faces danger on the beach, getting lost and swept up into a fight between two raging bulls. As winter arrives, the reindeer herd in Norway must migrate to their grazing grounds in the mountains but this involves a perilous two-mile swim across open water | Nature documentary narrated by Ewan McGregor. Stormborn follows the resilient animals surviving in the harsh, arctic and subarctic, conditions of Iceland, the Shetlands and the Monach Isles. We see how creatures as diverse as reindeer, arctic fox, puffins, seals and otters manage to live in such a demanding environment | Director: Jackie Savery | Cast: Ewan McGregor

The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the species | Director: Hannah Hoare, Matthew Thompson | Cast: Gillian Burke

programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep1 «Arctic Secrets»…The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet | With its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. This documentary series takes a look at the people and animals for whom the Arctic is home. We see how Inuit tribes, orcas, polar bears and more survive the challenges of living in the severe climate of the northernmost part of our planet. The tribes and species of the Arctic have spent thousands of years learning how to adapt to the change of the seasons. They must now adapt to a new threat; the impact of climate change | Director: Allan Code

programme.desc: Recently, special agent of Russian intelligence Yegor Kremnev has been plagued by failures. programme.title: Praying mantises – masters of camouflage
programme.desc: First insights into the behavior of the praying mantis: highly precise hunting, excellent camouflage mechanisms and reproduction - documented with the latest camera and slow motion technology. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild weather – On the trail of climate research
programme.desc: Heat, drought, storms, floods – the weather seems to be going crazy around the world. Are heat records in Germany or Canada, forest fires in Alaska and melting pack ice the consequences of climate change or coincidence? The icebreaker “Polarstern” set off on September 20, 2019 on a year-long Arctic expedition to help understand global weather phenomena. – The state of knowledge, without alarmism.

programme.title: Phantom of the Deep Sea – The Giant Squid
programme.desc: It is not an invention from novels like Moby Dick and 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea. But for a long time people searched for the “deep sea monster” in vain. High tech and tricks made it possible: in 2012, the world's largest octopus was photographed in its natural habitat using diving robots. A milestone in deep sea research.

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: There are around three million shipwrecks sunk in waters worldwide. They are often the target of looters hoping to make valuable discoveries. They also succumb to decay over time. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark – Fixed die Haie
programme.desc: Poor weather conditions at sea prevent the team's next dive and make some feel sick. To lighten the mood, Steve plans a little island trip. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark – Fixed die Haie
programme.desc: All team members have completed their training. Now it's time for their first dive with the nurse shark - a sea hunter that they have only observed from the boat. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Majestic whales, playful dolphins, curious seals and powerful polar bears: fascinating insights into the survival strategies of marine mammals. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Sea and land turtles impress with their variety of shapes and their sophisticated adaptations. Their life between land, river and sea shows how resilient they are. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Over 20 species of crocodiles, alligators and caimans live in 91 countries. Their behavior shows that there is more to teeth and scales than mere danger. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Elephants roam the wild in Africa and Asia. Intelligence, memory and strength make them fascinating survivors. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: What is behind the heaviest land animals in the world? Rhinos and hippos are not only among the most impressive creatures in the animal kingdom. They also possess amazing abilities. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: There are 91 different species of antelope worldwide. 70 of them live in Africa. The annual migration of the elegant and graceful animals through the savannah is a unique natural spectacle. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: From polar bears to sun bears: eight species share a similar body structure but live differently. Behavior and adaptations show exciting similarities. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Tigers, lions, leopards and jaguars are among the largest cats of prey. With their strength, camouflage and hunting technology, they are feared hunters in Africa, Asia and America. (Station info).

programme.title: Animalically aloof
programme.desc: Elegant fliers and agile hunters: animals such as hummingbirds, sparrowhawks and albatrosses overcome gravity with unique flight techniques and thus ensure their survival. (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: The Luangwa Valley is located in East Africa, far from civilization. Here the Luangwa River meanders for over 800 kilometers through lush green grasslands. Floods during the rainy season cause the vegetation to flourish. The dry season forces the zebras and other animals to gather near the river. A great meal for the leopards.

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: Galapagos – an isolated paradise full of unique species. The islands are characterized by lava deserts and volcanoes. Sea lions hunt in teams, giant tortoises fight for survival. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild dogs: hunters between worlds
programme.desc: Fascinating journey to wild dogs: From the majestic Arctic wolf to the tiny fennec fox. A look at their habitats and survival strategies in extreme regions. (Station info).

programme.title: Small animals on a long journey
programme.desc: A tiny chameleon hatches in Madagascar's forests and fights for survival. In the Scottish Highlands, a black field mouse is desperately looking for protection and a mate. (Station info).

programme.title: Penguins up close
programme.desc: Penguins raise their offspring in difficult conditions. Building a nest requires a lot of creativity - plus there are often extreme temperatures and predators. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc: From arctic cold to midsummer: the living conditions on Hokkaido are a challenge for animals. Nevertheless, many species such as the brown bear live on Japan's northernmost island. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild School – orphans in the animal kingdom
The Age of Nature
programme.desc: The Río Chagres flows directly into the Panama Canal. As a result of climate change and rainforest deforestation, the level of the river, which is Panama's most important shipping route and source of income, is falling. Today people are renaturing the forest and ensuring that scarce water is retained. This helps nature and the economy.\n\nExciting documentary about environmental projects worldwide that show how destroyed nature can recover.

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: On the Yucatan Peninsula, Steve chases a lightning-fast sailfish. A little later, the naturalist marvels at the spotted night snake's hunting skills. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: In the Australian outback, Steve's dream comes true: he meets an inland taipan, the most poisonous snake in the world. Back in Sydney he begins his search for a blue-ringed octopus. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: The firefly lures its prey to their doom with a light show. In the caves of New Zealand, Steve witnesses their hunting techniques before seeing sperm whales up close in a kayak. (Station info).

programme.title: The great migrations of animals
programme.desc: Bears and freezing temperatures in the high mountains of Canada and Alaska cannot stop them: caribou trek up to 5,000 kilometers to reach their breeding grounds. (Station info).

programme.title: Fascination Africa
programme.desc: South Africa's “Big Five” also find the best conditions away from the Kruger National Park. During the rainy season there is plenty of water and food for elephants, rhinos and Cape buffalo. Lions and leopards, on the other hand, find it easier to catch prey in the dry season. “Animals in the MalaMala Reserve”.

programme.title: Marmots
programme.desc: A year with the marmots on the Großglockner: Between climate change, territorial wars, the danger of eagles and traffic, a family holds its own in the middle of the Alpine wilderness. (Station info).

programme.title: TRỪ BẠO AN LƯƠNG - PUNISH EVIL
programme.desc: Một lô hàng tiền mới phát hành bị ba tên cướp có vũ trang cướp, khiến thám tử Chang phải điều tra. Lần theo những manh mối mới, anh đã hạ gục thành công một trong những tên cướp. Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: ANH HÙNG THỜI LOẠN - YOUNG HEROES OF CHAOTIC TIMES
programme.desc: Câu chuyện này lấy bối cảnh ở Thượng Hải vào cuối triều đại nhà Thanh, kể về một chàng trai trẻ, Chen Zhen, người đã vươn lên trở thành anh hùng dân tộc sau khi chịu đựng gian khổ và vượt qua thử thách trong cuộc sống.

programme.title: BÃO TỐ BANGKOK - BANGKOK STORM
programme.desc: Võ sĩ ngầm Lin Feng bị bộ ba Bangkok truy lùng khi từ chối đấu trong một trận đấu trái luật. Anh trốn thoát thành công nhưng bị mất trí nhớ. Trong khi Feng bắt đầu cuộc sống mới, hội tam hoàng tìm thấy anh và thuê một võ sĩ hàng đầu để đánh bại anh. Khi Feng đột nhiên lấy lại trí nhớ trong quá trình đó, anh thề sẽ tiêu diệt bộ ba.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

Trong khi Feng bắt đầu cuộc sống mới, hội tam hoàng tìm thấy anh và thuê một võ sĩ hàng đầu để đánh bại anh. Khi Feng đột nhiên lấy lại trí nhớ trong quá trình đó, anh thề sẽ tiêu diệt bộ ba.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: THANH XÀ - TIỀN DUYÊN - THE FATE OF REUNION
programme.desc: Hàng ngàn năm trước, Green Snake đã được giác ngộ dưới sự hướng dẫn của Dao Qing và dần dần yêu anh ta. Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết. Kể từ đó, cô bắt đầu tìm kiếm những tái sinh của Đạo Thanh trong hàng trăm năm để giúp anh đảo ngược tình thế…

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.
